'a golden opportunity in your academic career. Joining this grade level is a
'new experience and a transition to Grade 12 mathematics educations. At this
'grade level, you are expected to receive new and advanced opportunities that
'can help you learn and grow in the field of Mathematics, in life and work.
'Dear students, this textbook is organized in such a way that there is an
'introductory remark about how to use the textbook, some suggestions about
'how to care the textbook so that it will serve for many beneficiaries for a long
'period of time, and basic units are addressed after the introduction section.

'Matrices, Determinants and their Properties, Vectors, Transformation of the

'introduction of a unit, the expected learning outcomes are presented. Once

'presented. In the end, summary and review exercise are packed, respectively.
